rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Survey finds developers code faster but spend more time on security reviews.
rationale.survey-input: Provides empirical data on developer perceptions useful for organizational survey design.
rationale.problem-statement-anchor: Anchors scaling inversion: 44% report spending more time reviewing AI code.
rationale.assistive: Explicitly compares risks of code completion tools versus full program creation.
rationale.agentic: Explicitly compares risks of full program creation tools versus code completion.
rationale.risk-security: Reports empirical survey results about perceived security of AI generated code.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Reports empirical result that 65% perceive overreliance as the greatest risk.
rationale.method-self-report: Evidence comes entirely from a survey of 105 software developers.
